title: tester report
description: What the tester ran and what came out. The supervisor reads this to decide whether the test phase passed.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what was run and the overall outcome.

command.description: The command that ran the test suite, e.g. `python3 -m pytest backend/tests`.

cases.description: One entry per test case that was executed.

expected.description: What the test should have produced.

passed.description: True only when every case passed and the suite exited zero.

failures.description: One entry per failing case, with the reason. Empty when everything passed.

regressions.description: Pre-existing failures that are not caused by this change. May be empty.

issue_comment_url.description: URL of the comment the tester left on the issue or the pull request.

blocked.description: True when the tester could not run the suite at all (missing dependency, no test command).

blocker_reason.description: Why the tester is blocked. Only meaningful when blocked is true.
